title: Zephyr: Rule Versioning implementation
description: Implement DIO Rule Version Option, Rule 255 fallback, decompression failure handling in Zephyr C
close_reason: Implemented DIO Rule Version Option (type 0x13) with parse/write functions and version compatibility check in Zephyr C. Added LICHEN_RPL_OPT_SCHC_RULE_VERSION, LICHEN_SCHC_RULE_SET_VERSION, lichen_rpl_schc_rule_version struct, parse/write functions, and versions_compatible inline. Builds and existing RPL tests pass.
